subject: The 2-minute secret 90% of users never discover
preview_text: How to do in 2 minutes what used to take 20. This changes everything about healing.
body_paragraphs: I used to spend 20 minutes every morning just trying to untangle my thoughts. Journaling felt like homework. Tracking my mood felt like a chore. I'd stare at a blank page, my brain just replaying the same painful loop. It was exhausting before my day even began.

Then I discovered something stupidly simple. The real work isn't in the length of time you spend, it's in the precision of the question you ask. You don't need a 20-minute therapy session with yourself at 7 AM. You need a 2-minute laser-guided prompt that cuts straight to what's actually hurting.

That's why I built the 'Daily Check-In' inside Fresh Start. It's not another journal. It's a single, powerful question from your AI therapist, based on your exact mood and yesterday's progress. It bypasses the rambling and gets to the core feeling in under 120 seconds. The AI then gives you one actionable insight, not a novel. It turns a draining morning ritual into a quick, clarifying reset.

Open the app right now. Tap 'Therapist Chat' and just say 'Daily Check-In'. Do it before your brain has time to overcomplicate it. See what one precise question can uncover in 2 minutes. P.S. The first users who tried this hack reported their 3AM spirals dropped by half. The data doesn't lie.
